desc:
Use Code: "RELEASE"

Run your own cozy boutique and make dresses and suits by hand! ✂️👗
Customers walk in with an event, a style and a budget. Take their measurements, design their outfit, then cut, pin and sew every piece yourself.
✨ Mix bodices, skirts, sleeves, collars and overlays in dozens of fabrics, prints and colours
🧵 Cut out pattern pieces with scissors and stitch them together
🎀 Finish with bows, lace, flowers, brooches and beads
⭐ Deliver for coins, tips and stars, and level up to unlock new styles
🪟 Show off your best work in your shop window, where other players can buy copies
🏆 Compete in the hourly Fashion Show
🐱 Pet your shop cat!
🎁 Claim daily rewards and playtime gifts
Up to 6 designers share a street, each with their own shop. Can you become the most famous designer in town?
